Why is the area of a circle pi r squared?
Here is a proof you can see.
Cut the circle into slices, like a pizza.
Now unroll them, one pointing up, the next pointing down.
It looks bumpy. So use more slices.
The bumps flatten out, until it is a rectangle.
How tall is it? Each slice is as long as the radius. So the height is r.
How wide? Half the crust is on top, half on the bottom.
So the width is half the circumference. Half of two pi r, which is pi r.
Area equals width times height. Pi r, times r.
Pi r squared. No formula to memorise. Just a pizza.
